headline: On a roll

highlights: Organic growth of 18% continues to be well ahead of pharma market, and management believes it has enough levers in business to ensure this growth run-rate.
EBITDA margin improvement of 140bps YoY to 5.3% was fuelled by cost discipline across segments and a rise in contribution from the Medtech business.
Post a robust H1FY27, management anticipates that Entero may surpass its FY27 revenue growth guidance of 23%.

The company is expected to generate >INR 2bn in operating cash flows in FY27, which may be deployed towards boosting growth through M&A or increasing its stake in subsidiaries that are not fully owned.
valuation: Source: SES ESG, I-sec research Earnings Revisions (%) FY27E FY28E Revenue 1.2 1.2 EBITDA 1.2 1.2 EPS (8.9) (5.6) Previous Reports 28-08-2026: Initiating Coverage Entero Healthcare Solutions | Results Update | 06 November 2026 India | Institutional Equity Research 2 Valuation and risks Entero continues to strengthen its position in the healthcare distribution market, with organic growth (+20%) ahead of industry.
At CMP the stock trades at 42.6x FY27E and 30.3x FY28E earnings and 18.1x FY28E and 13.8x FY28E EV/EBITDA.
We maintain BUY with an unchanged target price of INR 2,100, valuing the company at 17x FY28E EV/EBITDA (unchanged).
